title: Build a lunar excavator simulator in Unreal Engine
summary: A hobbyist asked Claude Code to design a Moon excavator inside an Unreal Engine folder and says it produced a working simulator with full controls.
agent_role: Claude Code designed the excavator and built the simulator and its controls inside the existing Unreal Engine project; the human only gave the one-line request.
outcome: Author reports ending up with a fully functional lunar excavator simulator with all controls, shown in a video.
what_they_did: The poster asked Claude Code, just for fun, to design an excavator that could work on the Moon. They had forgotten it was opened in their Unreal Engine experiments folder, a game engine project. The agent built the design right into the game engine.
how_it_went: They say they now have a fully working lunar excavator simulator with all the controls, and shared a video of it.
worth_knowing: The folder you open the agent in shapes what it builds; here a game engine project turned a design question into a playable simulator.
prompt: Inside my Unreal Engine project at [project folder], design a [machine, e.g. excavator] that would work on [setting, e.g. the Moon, with low gravity]. Build it as a drivable simulation with keyboard controls for each moving part. First show me your plan: the parts, the controls and the files you'll create or change. Wait for my approval before editing the project.

curation.rationale: A fun, surprising build with a video demo, but the post gives almost no detail on steps or effort.
